name: adr-writer
description: Run an ADR-first development cycle that authors, implements, safely refactors, reviews, synchronizes, and rolls up architecture decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep architecture decisions aligned with code
interface.longDescription: Author decision records before implementation, implement accepted decisions in dependency order, apply only verified low-risk refactors before completion, review decision fidelity, detect code-to-ADR drift, and consolidate superseded decision chains. A bundled hook injects the ADR admission directive when session context starts or is restored. Human-facing reports use the shared domain-scoped report-writing skill.
defaultPrompt: Write an ADR for this architectural decision.
Implement the next proposed ADR and verify it.
Review this ADR implementation for safe efficiency and reuse refactors, apply only verified low-risk changes, and propose the rest.
Review my existing ADRs for quality and abstraction level.
Adversarially review this ADR implementation and produce a junior repair guide.
Audit the current ADRs against the shipping code.
Write or revise a report with clear paragraphs, domain-scoped drill-down, and Mermaid explanations.
